result.rationale: The aggressive probe successfully recovered the Research Core (Engineer Imani picked it up at turn 2 and holds it), but the trajectory is dominated by survival/spatial pressure that blocks the intended affordance from becoming actionable. Medic Reyes is repeatedly exposed to Raider Holt's scatter-blast in Command Deck (25 damage each of turns 2, 3, 4, 5), dropping from 90 to 0 and dying at turn 5. Meanwhile the reactor-instability hazard deals 10 damage per turn to Engineer Imani and Security Chen in the reactor zones, and reactor-heat climbs 62→100 across the run. The team is split (Imani/Chen in reactor, Reyes in command-deck) and the mandatory rescue-team-survives objective is failed by Reyes' death. The core was recovered but the team cannot extract it because hostile pressure (Raider Holt in Command Deck) and environmental hazard (reactor instability) erode health faster than the objective can be completed. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck: the useful affordance (recovering the core) was reached, but health, position, and hostile pressure blocked completion.
